m1-declare-bookends.title: Pin the declaration with a test (red), then declare bookends in the three templates (green)
m1-declare-bookends.imperative: TDD, test-led. FIRST add a new test class to tests/test_checklist_engine.py asserting, per template (COMMANDER_SPINE, ADMIRAL_SPINE, EXPLORER_SPINE), the EXACT set of gate ids carrying task.get('bookend') is True, and every other gate in that template does NOT carry a truthy 'bookend' key -- an assertion that only checks 'at least one gate flagged' is insufficient. Run it and observe it FAIL against the current (undeclared) templates -- attest that as c1 (manual, RED). THEN add "bookend": true to exactly: COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json tasks.init and tasks.archive; ADMIRAL_SPINE.template.json tasks.init and tasks.closeout; EXPLORER_SPINE.template.json tasks.init and tasks.route -- on those six gates and no others, adding only the new key beside the existing per-task keys (status, rework_count, etc.), with no other reformatting. Confirm each edited template still parses as JSON and still instantiates via scripts/init_work_area.py --spine (or the equivalent instantiation path test_init_work_area.py already exercises) -- do this on a COPY in a temp dir, never against the live .agent-work/567-k/spine.json or .agent-work/epic-567-door/spine.json. Re-run the new test and observe it PASS -- c2 (command check).

preconditions.satisfied_by: m0-context complete: handoff/evidence/engine mechanism confirmed loaded

postconditions.statement: TDD red: new bookend-declaration pinning test written and observed FAILING against the undeclared templates -- manual attest (check MUST be null so the by-design-failing test is not itself run as a gate)
postconditions.satisfied_by: Added ShippedTemplateBookendDeclarations to tests/test_checklist_engine.py; ran pytest -k Bookend and observed 3 failed subtests (COMMANDER/ADMIRAL/EXPLORER templates all report got=[] vs expected two bookend gates each) -- RED confirmed against undeclared templates. 11 passed = pre-existing bookend engine-mechanism tests (#634), unaffected.

postconditions.statement: bookend declared on exactly the six named gates; templates still parse/instantiate; pinning test now passes

m3-e2e-proof.imperative: On a COPY of the Commander template in a temp dir (never the live spine files), drive it through a fresh `python scripts/checklist_engine.py` process: mark init..plan complete and execute in-progress, then attempt `amend` with delta {"ops":[{"op":"drop","id":"archive"}]} and confirm it is REFUSED, citing 'bookend'. Capture the exact refusal text. Attest c1 with the pasted refusal as evidence.
